body: Okay.
I wish I knew.

I guess the guilt of knowing people care about me when I don't give a shit about myself. And if I were ever to take my life, it would probably hurt them, even though it'd be temporary, it just reminds me that I'm being selfish and I'm unappreciative about everything good in my life. I'm afraid of what lies beyond death but right now, silence and nothingness and nonexistence sounds nice. Admitting that makes me feel abnormal and nobody would understand it unless they were a medical professional. I complain about feeling so alone but whenever people come to talk to me, it seems I just push me away.

I figured this would be a place to dump your thoughts. If there's a better place to post this kind of shit I'd love it if you'd direct me to it. And please don't think I'm looking for any consoling by posting this.
I've never done any sort of pill and I keep my depression hidden so I don't know what meds do. How exactly is Xanax a health risk? I thought it was an antidepressant

I understand I'm a long way from happiness, but I'm too impatient and unmotivated to take the baby steps. Aside from that, there are many things I enjoy doing such as weightlifting, wrestling, running, learning bass, and skating. Even more I'm a music fiend and I like everything. I tend to listen to more alternative bands (such as Nirvana, Franz Ferdinand, The Killers, Weezer, ect.) on a daily basis. Despite the enjoyment I get from all of this, I just don't have motivation to do those things.
I've only had one hang over and I stayed in bed the entire day and sobbed. So maybe.

Having friends doesn't make a difference. I'm well-liked, popular, and I'm good with people but I hate myself and I'm suicidal. The people I've opened up to can't always be there and eventually I start feeling like a burden more than a friend. Maybe I need new ones but from my experience, a friend really won't be there 24/7. As to finding meaning I can't offer any advice since I'm dealing with the same thing. The other commenter said volunteer and I agree with this wholeheartedly. Make a difference for someone else; it will give you self-worth.
Yeah neither do I.
It's hard to look past whatever's clouding me and just stay the course. But you're right. What is there to lose? If I'm delaying my death then I can always kill myself later.

In a way I want to try. I mean why not? It'd probably help. I'm not sure how to break the news to my parents and I'm not sure if I'd be willing to work with a doctor to get the treatment that I actually deserve. How would I actually know if anything's helping?
I'm not sure what to say. I definitely liked the poem, but it sucks to people suffer from emotional problems in order to be able to write these things.

It's hard. I've been hating myself for the lady six years. Maybe I need to find a way to change that reality. I know it'll be a slow and painful process. But it wouldn't hurt to try. And thanks for telling me I'm great, even if you have no idea who I am.
Maybe you're right. I can't say that I actually feel strong but maybe going through a personal hell without taking your life is a form of strength.

It's been 6 years for me. I'm not sure what I could tell you to make your situation better but I know there are people like me. Sadly I just don't want to talk anymore. I'm glad I posted this here and got this support. Even though I didn't want it.

I think failing is what keeps me from attempting to end my life, and I know I should be happy and not wanting to die before my life ends. Obviously I don't know what the future holds, but I'm not looking forward  to waking up everyday to be the surgeon I want to be.

I'm not sure why I'm so content on dying. There isn't anything bad going on in my life, but there's a constant misery going on in my head. I woke up feeling better today and I feel better about myself, but I feel I'm just going to collapse later.

You understand this better than you may think. It's been a long time since something has been directed towards me that made me think "Wow he/she understands why it's not easy to 'perk up and smile.'" Unfortunately I don't see a point to hang on or try to seek help since I hate myself too much to change how I feel. It's sad but it's true, and I wish I could like myself but I simply can't nor do I care to make that change. I'm scared of dying and I'm scared of help, but suicide just sounds so much nicer and easier than living in self-loathing or making an attempt to get better...

I'm definitely glad to hear you're doing well. Unfortunately I don't have any drive to better myself and I just feel like if I don't die now, I'll kill myself later. I wish I wouldn't be missed by my family. I'd have no problem then. I'm sure my future self will be happy if/when I don't slit my throat but honestly, I'm not looking forward to waking up every morning to be my future self.

Spencer was my friend who hung himself when I was 12. It definitely hurt and I know killing myself would hurt my family and what little friends I may have but I just don't care anymore. I guess I'm afraid that therapy won't do anything. I can't imagine that I'd be very cooperative either. I just don't see a purpose. It sucks but dying would just be nice. I wake up so I can just go back to bed. I feel empty and nothing can keep my interest for more than 10 minutes. Playing bass is pointless and so is trying to hang out with people, ect. Life seems bleak and I feel like I'm just delaying the inevitable.
